-------------------- DEPOSIT -----------------

--Total Month-To-Date Average Daily Balance

SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPeriodBalance]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD]


--Year-To-Date Average Daily Balance
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[CasaTdAggregateBalance]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD]


--Total Outstanding Balance
SELECT SUM(TRAN_DATE_BAL)  FROM [BUSC].[DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE] WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(8),EOD_DATE,112) = '20230127' --167095928591.9400
SELECT SUM(BalanceAmount)  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPeriodBalance] WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(8),PERIODENDDATE,112) = '20230127' --588493620.30000
SELECT SUM(BalanceAmountFull)  FROM [DW].[FactDepositsOutstandingBalance] WHERE BusinessDateSK = '20230127' --791765166434.90991


-------------------- LOANS -----------------

--Total Relationship Exposure
SELECT TOP 1 ACID, END_EOD_DATE  FROM [BUSC].[LNS_EODACCTBAL]
SELECT TOP 1 CustomerAccountID  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPeriodBalance]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactLoansRelationshipExposure]

--Due for the Month
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[LNS_LADMD]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[LNS_LAPENALDMD]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[RepaymentPlanPayment]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactLoansOutstandingBalance]

--Credit Limit
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[LNS_LIMITLIAB]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[LNS_GENERALACCTMAST]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[LimitLiabilitySanction]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit]



-------------------- CARDS -----------------

--Total Relationship Exposure
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[CCD_CBCEXCACFP]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactCardsRelationshipExposure]

--Statement Balance
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[CCD_CBCEXCACFP]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[PaymentCardStatementSummary]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactCardsRelationshipExposure]
--Credit Limit
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[CCD_CBCEXCACFP]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit]
SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [DW].[FactCardsCreditLimit]


-------------------- TRUST -----------------
--Total Fund Value
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[TRU_AUMUITF]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[TRU_AUMNONUITF]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[UITFAUMBalance]
SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [DW].[FactTrustFundValue]

--Total Outstanding Investment
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[TRY_TRADES] --With Data
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountBalance]
SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [DW].[FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment]


-------------------- SECURITIES -----------------
--Total Portfolio Size
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BUSC].[SEC_PORTFOLIO]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountSecuritiesPortfolio]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[FactSecurityPortfolio]


-------------------- CUSTOMER -----------------
--Total Relationship Exposure


SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[Total Relationship Exposure]
SELECT TOP 1 *  FROM [DW].[Total Relationship Exposure (CCD)
